meaning: A computer program trained on huge amounts of writing. It learns patterns in language, so it can write and answer in sentences.
clues: It is a kind of computer program.
It mostly works with words, not rows of numbers.
It learned by reading a gigantic pile of writing from books and websites.
It makes sentences by guessing which word is likely to come next, again and again.
It has three words, and its short form is LLM. The first word starts with L and means very big.
assumes: A spreadsheet is a grid for numbers
An operating system runs a computer

decoys.meaning: A program with a grid of rows and columns for numbers and math.
The main program that runs a phone or computer and lets other apps work.
A big collection of facts kept on a computer in an organized way.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: I could hold one short report. This thing learned from more writing than a person could read in many lifetimes!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Impressive, but it can sound sure and still be wrong. Tip: double-check any fact that matters.

why: It can write answers in sentences, but you should still check them.
